title: Open WebUI inline model metadata -- T1005 known file id returns another user's knowledge chunks
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin observed rules (derived from breach corpus)
description:
Vendor-disclosed detection for CVE-2026-70487 (GHSA-6xhv-rxhv-pwm4,
CVSS 5.3 MEDIUM), affecting Open WebUI from 0.8.8 until 0.11.0.

Inline direct model metadata accepted client-supplied knowledge
attachments without filtering them against the CALLER's read access.
Any authenticated user who simply knew another user's file id -- ids
that are often sequential or otherwise guessable -- could have the
built-in knowledge tools return indexed chunks from that file, a
read-only cross-user confidentiality loss. Knowledge-base-level
permissions and saved-workspace model validation were unaffected; the
gap was specifically in the inline-attachment path bypassing the
per-file read check the rest of the system enforces.

Detection logic flags a chat/completion request whose inline knowledge
attachment references a file id NOT owned by (or shared with) the
authenticated caller -- the exact authorization check the vulnerable
path skipped.

Aggregated from 1 first-party vendor security advisory (open-webui, via
GHSA and NVD, citing the exact fix commit), fixed in 0.11.0.
